description: NaNiPO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.61 Å. Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NiO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.00 Å) and four longer (2.24 Å) Ni-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-52°. There are two shorter (1.53 Å) and two longer (1.58 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ni, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one P atom.
